_comment: skills-lock.json — pinned skill sources for bob-cloud-codegen.
A skill is a SKILL.md file that Bob loads via use_skill. It can come from any source.
This file records where each installed skill came from and what version/commit was
vendored, so the workspace is reproducible and auditable.

event-driven-python-patterns.description: Event-driven Python patterns covering AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, GCP Cloud Run, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Pub/Sub, Service Bus handlers, batching, idempotency, and DLQ routing.

enterprise-integration-adapters.description: Python client adapter patterns for Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Kafka, EventBridge/SQS, Cloud Pub/Sub, Azure Service Bus, and Apache Iceberg with dependency injection and mockability. Pattern guidance only; SDK facts must be verified per rule 05.

llm-prompt-and-pipeline-patterns.description: LLM invocation pipelines, prompt template management in prompts/, structured output extraction (Pydantic), token budgeting, exponential backoff, and PII sanitization in Python.

code-quality-and-review.description: Review checklist, P0/P1/P2 severity criteria, and the review-findings block format for generated Python source. Single home of the findings format used by code-reviewer and cloud-codegen.
